scope: One bounded ABC training and development evaluation; no D, simulation, collection, closed-loop, upload, controller changes or further tuning. User increases prior proposed600 to fixed1500 updates and adds controls.

data.split_unit: root_id; old4 and new3 pairs per root remain dependent; all retained
data.selection: combined Ctune21pairs over6roots; root-macro equally weighs roots; Ccal21pairs never used by optimizer or checkpoint selection

sampling: uniform complete-permutation stream within each cohort; carry residual entries across batches; same 24000 example presentations per run, no failure/success reweighting, no dropped tail; generator seed10000+seed
loss: same mean three-group weighted BCE +0.05*mean(object SmoothL1,scene SmoothL1), full valid seven facts; shared pooledAB class weights in BOTH cohorts isolate data exposure from loss-weight change
architecture: unchanged full LatentTransition,76224 parameters; original residual zero-last-layer initialization; identical initialization per seed across cohorts
freeze: DINO, RGBv1, normalizer, current-state encoder/GRUs, exact shared held/in/open heads, .5 thresholds, controller, labels and old copy effects

selection.per_seed: minimum combined Ctune root-macro weighted BCE, tie earlier update
selection.representative_per_cohort: minimum selected Ctune score, tie lowerseed
selection.additional_equal_update_comparison: also report final1500 checkpoints for both cohorts; always finish1500, no early stop or extension

symbolic_baseline.inputs: 7 current observed ternary predicates (UNKNOWN=-1), then same9 declared action features; no GT-current labels, latent, outcome, actual duration, root colour or future
symbolic_baseline.criterion: weighted Gini with same pooledAB group class weights
symbolic_baseline.split_tie: lowest feature, then lowest threshold; no zero-gain split
symbolic_baseline.output: leaf weighted positive frequency, same .5 threshold and frozen multiple-held UNKNOWN rule
symbolic_baseline.implementation: local pure numpy deterministic CART; self-checks saved before fit

development_criteria.scope: development candidate for a possible ONE future independent one-step validation only, not original full-guide acceptance
development_criteria.representative_aug132: oldC24/24 and newC18/18 all7 known correct; newC pairedtarget6/6 and pairedfull7 6/6
development_criteria.same_budget_data_benefit: mean newC pairedfull7 root rate augmented strictly above old96 at final1500; mean oldC rootmacroall7 not lower
development_criteria.complexity_assessment: report tree comparison separately; a tie or loss cannot establish neural advantage. If development gates pass but tree ties, any independent validation must include the tree and explicitly test added value; no requirement to strictly beat a saturated100% metric
development_criteria.if_fail: report first impactful error, single actual-successor-latent replacement with same head using saved predictions, no retrain or extra experiment

input_contract.GT: after labels and actual successor latent only supervised targets; before labels only scoring/masks
